newsitem.title: INDIA: Bank of India trading to begin on BSE next week.
newsitem.headline: Bank of India trading to begin on BSE next week.

text.p: State-run Bank of India is likely to begin trading on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in the new account on Monday, an exchange official told Reuters.
"It's almost certain that trading will begin from the new settlement on Monday," he said, adding that there was some late paperwork to be completed.
The bank raised 6.75 billion rupees in February through an inital public offering of equity.
Bank of India said earlier this week its net profit for the year ended March 31, 1997 rose to 4.48 billion rupees from 2.76 billion a year ago.
The shares will also begin trading on the National and Ahmedabad bourses next week.
